name: Loki
subtitle: Master of Mischief
description: Direct Mischief and Mayhem in the battle as you weave your Charm and Confusion on your Foes
lore: For the infamous trickster of Asgard, Ryvan is ripe with opportunity, mischief and havoc waiting to be unleashed. He acts not only of his own accord, but guided by the whispers of Chaos itself as it works to thwart Destiny and Order. Yet Loki still pursues his own agenda, planning to grow close enough to influence Chaos—or perhaps even usurp it…
divinity_generator: Gain [50] Divinity when inflicting damage to an enemy under [Sleep].

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Ignore RES +20%, Turn Meter Multiplier +20%, DMG Reduction Multiplier +20%
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%

skills.name: Shadow Step
skills.description: Attack all enemies (140%ATK+250%ACC) with an 80% chance to place [mechanic:corrupt] on each target for 2 turns. Then place [mechanic:vanish] and [mechanic:backfire] on this hero for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: When attacking under [Vanish], steal a random [Buff] or extend a random [Debuff] by 1 turn

skills.name: Trickster's Deflection
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (110%ATK+250%ACC) with a 75% chance to place [mechanic:charm] on the target for 1 turn.

skills.name: Unending Mischief
skills.description: When [mechanic:sleep] expires or is removed from an enemy, decrease their Turn Meter by 20%.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also place [SPD Down II] on the target for 1 turn.

skills.name: Dreamweaver
skills.description: Place [mechanic:sleep] on all enemies for 1 turn. If the target is already under [mechanic:sleep], increase its duration by 1 turn and steal 10% of the target's Turn Meter.
skills.awakening_bonus: If the target resists [Sleep], blocks or is immune, increase this hero’s turn meter by 20%.

imprint_passive: When [Sleep] expires or is removed from an enemy, decrease their Turn Meter by 10%.
